items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: No, well at that time Guy, Campbell and Miss Janet and all of them was playing with Celestan then. Yeah. But I was back there at Chinatown, raising the devil with them boys, you see.

ctx.x: What happened to Celestan? He sat in the corner and held his own?

No, well at that time Guy, Campbell and Miss Janet and all of them was playing with Celestan then. Yeah. But I was back there at Chinatown, raising the devil with them boys, you see. We had a guy that was added attraction to that band, you understand, and after he left. See Celestan, anybody come, Sue was buried high, I mean Cindy Desvene too, you know. They were high, frankly all out of town. Now Cindy had a band, Bucket from Chicago and Porter was from Detroit and they had a lot of boys from Natchez and…
Well who was in the Yelping Hounds? I never remember.
